name: tarawing
description: Tarawing — astrology, tarot, and sacred-geometry card spreads. Convenience root only; server/ and client/ are independent npm projects with their own node_modules and lockfiles.

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
